newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-MIURA STRIKES TWICE IN JAPAN VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIURA STRIKES TWICE IN JAPAN VICTORY.

text.p: Japan beat a depleted Croatian side 4-3 on Sunday in the three-team Kirin Cup tournament which also involves Turkey.
Japan led 1-0 at half time, then the fireworks came with six goals after the break.
Veteran striker Kazuyoshi Miura scored two of the home side's second-half goals to underline his reputation as Japan's most lethal international.
Midfielder Takashi Hirtano, on his international debut, opened the scoring in the 35th minute.
Japan's winner came from substitute Hiroaki Morishima in injury time.
That made it 4-2. Croatia, playing without their top attackers Davor Suker, Zvonimir Boban and Alen Boksic, collected a consolation goal when Goran Vlaovic scored with the final kick of the match.
Earlier Croatia's Aljosa Asanovic drilled in a free kick from just outside the box in the 77th minute followed by a penalty two minutes later.
"'We couldn't overcome jet lag," said Croatia's Robert Prosinecki of Spanish club FC Sevilla.
Croatia play Turkey on Thursday while Japan take on the Turks next Sunday.
